title: auth: CredentialStore error type is String, should be typed enum
description: crates/auth/src/store.rs: from_content, from_file, merge_from_content, merge_from_file all return Result<_, String>. For a library crate this is non-idiomatic: callers cannot match on error variants, test assertions must use string contains(), and the type provides no structured information for logging or metrics. A typed CredentialStoreError enum with variants (Io(io::Error), MalformedLine{file:String,line:usize,msg:String}, BadHash{username:String}) would let callers distinguish parse errors from I/O errors.
notes: from_credentials currently panics on bad hash (appropriate for config-time validation) but from_content/from_file return String. Introduce CredentialStoreError in crates/auth and implement std::error::Error. Caller in server_stores.rs uses .map_err(|e| format!(...)) which would still work.
